To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the heat transfer phenomena of flat solar collector filled with nanofluids is strongly affected by the solid volume fraction of nanofluids.
the heat transfer rate of the flat plate solar collector can be increased significantly by using water/Ag nanfluids.
the heat transfer rate, average temperature and collector efficiency increases with increasing solid volume fraction of water/Ag nanfluid.

the heat transfer and entropy generation analysis of solar collector filled with water/Cu, Ag, and Cu/Ag nanofluids.
